limits: No timing, throughput, hardware-utilization or bandwidth measurement is included.
20 Cube cores and 6/1 per-rank heads are explicit scenario assumptions; runtime measured cores and actual batch mix must match.
Counts are per one layer and one attention invocation, not the full model or all MTP rounds.
History scans from sink to context: masked recent rows count because the kernel loads and unpacks before masking.
Logical GM bytes describe named buffers, not HBM transactions; caches, bursts, metadata/table loads, scores/P/PV and other model operations are excluded.
Live-equivalent lower and full-tile upper quantify logical data/padding, not measured traffic bounds. Only history staging is included; current/window use aligned tails.
Splits partition history; never multiply full-history read bytes by the split count.
Task bytes are one complete prepare descriptor table; CV additionally reads those descriptors and writes per-layer statuses.
No split policy, arithmetic order, kernel source, startup parameter or timer changes are implied.

Packed live and full-tile staging counters sum logical API payloads for valid tasks; they must never be labeled actual HBM bytes, physical bandwidth, unique-address footprint or elapsed-time measurements.

import hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
from oscar_ascend.runtime import WorkspaceGeometry
from oscar_ascend.ops.cv_dispatch import select_cv_op,OFFICIAL_CV_MAP
from tools.serving_variants import variant_config
root=Path.cwd()
c=variant_config(json.loads((root/'configs/target.json').read_text()),'candidate')
flags={k:c.get('experimental_'+k,False) for k in ('fast_unpack','mixed_cv','striped_cache','decode_bundle','c4_member_pipeline','mdl_decode','c16_member_pipeline','hybrid_l1_decode','c16_l1_reuse','bf16_attention')}
g=WorkspaceGeometry(tokens=16384,query_heads=6,kv_heads=1,head_dim=256,cube_cores=20,history_cluster_size=16,aligned_math=True,official_math=True)
header=(root/'csrc/include/oscar_cv_schedule.h').read_text()
for formula in ('(tokens+queryTile-1)/queryTile','QueryTiles()*perToken','(workId%QueryTiles())*queryTile','workId/QueryTiles()','token*perToken+Segment(workId)'):
    assert formula in header,'Owner formula changed; re-audit before counting'
decode=(root/'csrc/kernels/attention_cv_official_decode.cpp').read_text()
assert 'OSCAR_CV_RUN(4)' in decode and 'OSCAR_CV_RUN(1)' in decode
assert 'start+=kKvRows' in decode
assert 'kAttentionKvRows = 256' in (root/'csrc/include/oscar_attention_launch.h').read_text()
cases=[]
for context in (32768,65536):
 for B in (16,28):
  N=4*B; S=g.splits_for_tokens(N)
  for q in (4,1):
   route=OFFICIAL_CV_MAP[select_cv_op(16,6,1,N,q,q1_draft=q==1,**flags)]
   assert route==('attention_cv_official_decode_out' if q==4 else 'attention_cv_official_decode_q1_out')
   tiles=(N+q-1)//q; factor=3*S
   leaders=[0]*20; history=[0]*20; total=[0]*20; lengths=[]
   ranges=((min(c['sink_tokens'],context),context),(0,min(c['sink_tokens'],context)+context-max(min(c['sink_tokens'],context),context+1-c['recent_tokens'])),(context,context+q))
   for source,(first,last) in enumerate(ranges):
    width=(last-first+S-1)//S
    for split in range(S):
     begin=min(last,first+split*width); end=min(last,begin+width); count=(end-begin+255)//256
     if source==0:lengths.append(end-begin)
     for request in range(B):
      token=q*request; work_id=(source*S+split)*tiles+token//q; core=work_id%20
      total[core]+=count
      if source==0:leaders[core]+=1; history[core]+=count
   live=B*(context-min(c['sink_tokens'],context)); rounded=sum(history)*256
   # Mirror LoadPackedInto's two AIV lanes x two HalfKv64 subtiles for every
   # history tile. Pipeline first-load plus PrefetchKeys visits each tile once.
   requested_rows=0
   first,last=ranges[0]; width=(last-first+S-1)//S
   for split in range(S):
    begin=min(last,first+split*width); end=min(last,begin+width)
    for start in range(begin,end,256):
     for sub in range(2):
      for lane in range(2):
       requested_rows+=max(0,min(64,end-start-sub*128-lane*64))
   assert requested_rows*B==live
   cases.append(dict(context_tokens=context,batch_requests=B,phase='main_q4' if q==4 else 'later_mtp_q1',route=route,padded_tokens=N,active_query_tokens=B*q,query_rows_per_request=q,source_splits=S,owner_tile=q,query_tiles=tiles,scheduled_work_items=tiles*factor,task_descriptors=N*factor,task_descriptor_bytes=N*factor*128,attention_status_tensor_bytes=N*factor*4,merge_output_rows=N*6,merge_partial_rows=N*6*factor,history_leaders=B*S,history_split_token_lengths=lengths,history_leaders_per_core=leaders,history_leaders_per_core_min_max=[min(leaders),max(leaders)],history_kv256_iterations_per_core=history,history_kv256_iterations_per_core_min_max=[min(history),max(history)],all_three_sources_kv256_iterations_per_core=total,all_three_sources_kv256_iterations_per_core_min_max=[min(total),max(total)],logical_history_gm_bytes=dict(packed_live_read=live*144,packed_full_tile_equivalent_upper=rounded*144,bf16_kv_staging_write_live_equivalent_lower=live*1024,bf16_kv_staging_write_full_tile=rounded*1024,bf16_kv_staging_read_live_equivalent_lower=live*1024,bf16_kv_staging_read_full_tile=rounded*1024)))
paths=('oscar_ascend/runtime.py','oscar_ascend/ops/cv_dispatch.py','tools/serving_variants.py','configs/target.json','csrc/include/oscar_cv_schedule.h','csrc/include/oscar_attention_launch.h','csrc/kernels/attention_official_tasks.cpp','csrc/kernels/attention_cv_official_decode.cpp')
result=dict(schema=1,kind='static_work_count_not_measurement',assumptions=dict(cube_cores=20,query_heads_per_rank=6,kv_heads_per_rank=1,head_dim=256,workspace_token_capacity=16384,uniform_requests=True,valid_slots_and_page_tables=True,padding_holes_in_live_prefix=False,main_decode_query_rows=4,later_mtp_padded_rows_per_request=4,context_is_total_cached_tokens_before_this_attention=True,later_q1_live_rows_are_leading_B=True),candidate_selector_flags=flags,sources_sha256={p:hashlib.sha256((root/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths},cases=cases)
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))

byte_metric_definitions.packed_live_read: Exact sum of requested DataCopyPad blockLen payloads for valid nonempty history tasks and valid physical-page mappings: B*(context-min(sink,context))*144. Includes recent-window positions masked only after QK. Not unique physical bytes, cache-line traffic, actual HBM transactions or a measurement.
byte_metric_definitions.packed_full_tile_equivalent_upper: Arithmetic envelope obtained by rounding each split to KV256 and multiplying by 144. This is NOT requested by LoadPackedInto: out-of-range tail rows are zero-filled in UB and issue no packed GM copy. It is not an HBM upper bound.
byte_metric_definitions.bf16_kv_staging_write_live_equivalent_lo: Unpadded data-volume equivalent: live history candidates * 2(K,V)*D256*2(BF16). This hypothetical live-only volume is NOT the actual fixed-tile staging copy count or an HBM lower bound.
byte_metric_definitions.bf16_kv_staging_write_full_tile: Exact requested logical staging payload under the valid scenario: each history KV256 iteration publishes 2 subtiles * 2 AIV lanes * 64 rows * D256 * 2 bytes * 2(K,V). Tail padding is included; this is not measured HBM traffic.
byte_metric_definitions.bf16_kv_staging_read_live_equivalent_low: Same hypothetical unpadded data-volume equivalent as the write lower field; not a physical memory bound.
byte_metric_definitions.bf16_kv_staging_read_full_tile: Exact logical K/V operand payload requested by the two per-tile Nd2Nz GM-to-L1 copies: QK reads K256xD256 BF16 and PV reads V256xD256 BF16. Caches, bursts and layout transaction details are not modeled.

read_path_audit.health_condition: Positive qcount, no taskError, TaskValid true, dequantMode valid and valid physical pages. Invalid metadata can bypass tasks or suppress per-page packed DMA and is outside these healthy-workload counts.
read_path_audit.history_candidate_interval: [min(sink,context), context), split into disjoint contiguous ranges
read_path_audit.task_dispatch: csrc/kernels/attention_cv_official_decode.cpp:154-160 only skips padded/error tasks; nonempty kind0 enters HistoryVectorTask without a recent/window test.
read_path_audit.tile_visitation: csrc/kernels/attention_cv_official_decode.cpp:746-764 loads the first KV256 tile and prefetches each subsequent tile exactly once. No entire tile is skipped based on recent cut.
read_path_audit.packed_payload: csrc/kernels/attention_cv_official_decode.cpp:299-315 clamps live rows to the split end and requests kSlotBytes=144 per live row. Virtual128 boundaries split DMA calls but do not duplicate payload. Physical mapping failures skip affected rows.
read_path_audit.recent_mask: csrc/kernels/attention_cv_official_decode.cpp:522-526 limits visible kind0 scores only after packed load/dequant/QK; the last recent-1=255 past tokens are still read for these 32K/64K cases.
read_path_audit.current_range: csrc/kernels/attention_official_tasks.cpp:150-152 separates history ending at context from current starting at context; current input tokens do not enter this packed-history payload.
read_path_audit.staging_path: csrc/kernels/attention_cv_official_decode.cpp:665-672 always publishes full HalfKv64 K/V; 725-730 and 196-207 request full KV256 K/V operands for history, including padded tails.
read_path_audit.reproduction_check: Embedded script separately enumerates split/tile/subtile/AIV-lane live rows using the loader clamp and asserts equality with the packed payload formula.
